summary: AMR Resources Acquisition Corp., a Cayman Islands blank-check company, filed an 8-K announcing that unit holders may separate units into Class A ordinary shares and warrants starting September 8, 2026. Each unit consists of one ordinary share and one-half of one redeemable warrant, each whole warrant exercisable at $11.50 per share. Separation requires broker contact with Continental Stock Transfer Trust. The ordinary shares and warrants will trade separately on Nasdaq under AMAC and AMACW, while units continue under AMACU. This is a routine administrative event enabling separate trading, not a special situation requiring M&A or restructuring classification.
